name: TechNova Fest
brief: Organise TechNova, a two-day college tech fest for about 1,500 students. It has a 24-hour hackathon, a robotics competition, three workshops and an evening concert. We need sponsors, venue and permissions, social media marketing, online registrations, stage, sound and lighting, food stalls, volunteers and security, and post-event accounts. Organising team of about eleven students; the fest should happen before the end-semester break, about nine weeks out.

tasks.name: Finalize hackathon rules and judging criteria
Run the two‑day fest (hackathon, competition, workshops, concert)
Finalize post‑event accounts and sponsor thank‑you letters
Collect participant feedback and compile report

risks.title: Venue permission delay
risks.cause: The municipal office processes event permits slower than anticipated
risks.event: Permit approval is received later than planned
risks.effect: Venue booking cannot be confirmed, pushing back logistics preparations
risks.response: Submit the permit application at least two weeks early and follow up weekly with the office

risks.title: Sponsor funding shortfall
risks.cause: Key sponsors reduce their pledged amounts after internal budget reviews
risks.effect: Insufficient funds for AV equipment may force a downgrade of sound and lighting
risks.response: Identify backup sponsors and secure a contingency fund equal to 10% of the total budget

risks.title: Branding assets not approved in time
risks.cause: Multiple stakeholder feedback cycles extend the designer’s work beyond the planned schedule
risks.event: Final branding and promotional assets are delivered late
risks.effect: Social media campaign launch is delayed, reducing participant registrations
risks.response: Set an internal review deadline two days before final delivery and limit revisions to two rounds

risks.title: Registration platform technical glitch
risks.cause: Integration with the payment gateway fails during testing phase
risks.event: The online registration platform crashes and cannot process sign‑ups
risks.effect: Participants cannot register, delaying data collection and potentially lowering attendance
risks.response: Perform thorough sandbox testing with the payment provider and prepare a manual registration backup form

risks.title: Volunteer dropout close to event
risks.cause: Many volunteers have final exams the week before the fest
risks.event: Around 40% of recruited volunteers withdraw their commitment
risks.effect: Training and briefing must be repeated and staffing gaps appear on event days
risks.response: Maintain a standby pool of 20% extra volunteers and cross‑train core team members to cover critical roles

risks.title: Hackathon rule ambiguity
risks.cause: Rules are finalized quickly to meet the schedule, limiting peer review
risks.effect: Judges dispute scores, delaying award ceremony and lowering participant satisfaction
risks.response: Run a peer review of the rules with faculty advisors and incorporate their feedback before final approval

risks.title: Sound and lighting equipment failure
risks.cause: Rental company provides older equipment with limited warranty coverage
risks.event: Main speaker blows out during the evening concert
risks.effect: Audio quality degrades, forcing a pause in the program and upsetting the audience
risks.response: Include a warranty clause and on‑site technician support in the rental contract

risks.title: Rain affecting outdoor food stalls
risks.cause: Weather forecast predicts heavy rain on the second day of the fest
risks.event: Outdoor food area becomes unsafe and unusable
risks.effect: Food vendors must be relocated, causing service gaps and participant dissatisfaction
risks.response: Arrange covered tents and pre‑identify an indoor backup location for food vendors

risks.title: Delay in robotics competition logistics
risks.cause: Coordinator waits for faculty advisor approval later than expected
risks.event: Logistics plan is completed only a week before the competition
risks.effect: Reduced setup time risks missing equipment delivery and hampers competition readiness
risks.response: Secure faculty advisor commitment early and set an internal deadline two weeks before the event

risks.title: Post‑event accounts reconciliation error
risks.cause: Finance team uses inconsistent expense tracking templates across sub‑tasks
risks.event: Accounting errors are discovered after sponsor thank‑you letters have been sent
risks.effect: Need to redo accounts, risking sponsor trust and delaying final reporting
risks.response: Standardize a single expense template and conduct an internal audit before final submission
